title: INC-071: checkout queueing during sale
body: Closed historical incident, 2026-07-12 16:20–16:48 UTC, ap-south-1. checkout-api reported payment-client acquisition timeouts while payment-api completed dispatched calls normally. The incident team found pending acquisitions against a worker-local ceiling of 12 during the sale. Restoring the previous ceiling of 48 removed the queue and errors subsided. Cause recorded for this incident: outbound pool exhaustion. This report concerns the July release, not the September deployment.
